title: Close sound: nail file and gel brush, loop
hook_ru: Так звучит маникюр вблизи
first_frame: Top-down macro, the file is already moving across a nail edge and fills about 60% of the frame. The rasp is audible from frame 0. Hook text fades in at 1 s, upper-middle.
what_happens: 0–1 s: file strokes with no words, only the real sound. 1–6 s: file passes along the edge, label «Пилка». 6–10 s: a slow brush pull of gel along the nail, label «Кисть с гелем». 10–11 s: payoff, the glossy finished nail turns into the light. 11–12 s: hard cut back to the first file stroke so it loops. No music. Series «Звук кресла», ep. 1. DM line: «послушай, залипательно». Save reason: a relaxing loop people replay.
why_stop: Sound onset and macro motion in frame 1. It breaks the hypothesised category convention of finished nails under trending music (E25), and the weak phone's one strength (≤30 cm audio) carries it.
why_share_or_save: Sent to a friend who likes ASMR/relaxing clips: «послушай перед сном». It is a reach piece, not a reference save.

title: Close sound: scissors on hair ends

what_happens: 0–1 s: snip on a strand, wordless. 1–8 s: a rhythm of snips along the comb-held strand. 8–11 s: payoff, the comb slides through the even ends and the cut hair falls onto the cape. 11–12 s: loop to the first snip. Series «Звук кресла», ep. 2. DM line: «это лучше любого ASMR».
